title: 37415 跟进：资料包校验对外部对象的注入字段给出「无存储」提醒，并合并测试文件
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37415. The source is seat 5's contract review on PR #37426 (record 7182623911, S2) and the seat's REWORK 7182630712. The owning area files it under the source card, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 · reach: authors whose `ai_context` pack is rooted on, or lists, an ADR-0015 `external` object and names an injected column · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：外部数据源的对象，平台会在定义里加上负责人、创建时间等字段，但外部库里其实没有这些列。资料包写了这类字段时，校验应当提醒「这一列外部没有存储，读取时会落空」，和其他规则已有的提醒一致。
- 谁受益：给外部对象写资料包的作者。
- 不做会怎样：校验通过，但 AI 实际读不到这些字段，作者不知道原因。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. After PR #37426, `validateAiContext` (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.ts`) judges a pack's names against the object with injected system columns merged, so an `external` object's injected `owner_id` / `created_at` / … pass. Those columns have no storage behind an external object, and the read degrades at query time. Wire the provenance check other rules already use (`unprovisionedInjectedColumnsFor`, as in `authored-site-expression.ts`) into every place the rule reads a field map. Use its own rule id (for example `ai-context-field-unprovisioned`, a `warning`), plus an `os explain` entry in `rule-explanations.ts`.
2. Also update the `os explain` text of `ai-context-field-unknown` in `rule-explanations.ts`. It still says "a name the object does not define", and should say that injected columns count.
3. Carried from the same review: once #37361 (PR #37412) has landed, fold `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/injected-system-columns.test.ts` (added by PR #37426) into `record-context-tools.test.ts` as a top-level describe. That follows AGENTS.md's one-harness rule. The new file existed only because #37361 held the shared file.

## Acceptance
- A pack naming an injected column on an `external` object gets the new warning, and the same pack on a non-external object gets none. Both are pinned.
- The new rule id has an `os explain` entry, and the `ai-context-field-unknown` explanation matches the rule.
- The injected-column executor pins live in the shared harness file, and the separate file is gone.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Blocked by: PR #37426 and PR #37412 on `main`.
Parent: #37415
Size: S
Dedupe (objectstack, is:issue): `ai-context-field-unprovisioned` 0 · `validate-ai-context external unprovisioned` 0.
